items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson listed as full participant in Wednesday practice, first time since ankle injury.
items.why: First full practice since high-ankle sprain; expected to play vs Bills.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense and Flowers efficiency.
items.opportunity: Lamar return boosts YPRR leader Flowers and Ravens pass game.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love returns to practice.
items.why: Ankle recovery progress on Wednesday report.
items.implication: Potential return to mix; monitor game status.
items.opportunity: Role expansion if cleared; Bam Knight reverse if not.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant at Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Potential limitation or sit; check Montgomery/handcuffs.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, elevated role for David Montgomery.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participant Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Could open targets for Jameson Williams if limited.
items.opportunity: Jameson Williams route/target upside if St. Brown restricted.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest (NIR-rest/ankle).
items.why: Rest designation with ankle; expected minor, full practice likely Thursday.
items.implication: Should be fine as WR1 vs Titans if progresses.

items.text: Time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield (Levitan/Silva discussion).
items.why: Return usage and coach comments support expanded role vs Dobbins/Harvey.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, shaded coverage, and limited supporting threats.
items.why: Elite efficiency and production vs opportunity metrics.
items.opportunity: High target share and YAC continue.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated previous chest injury on reverse last week; status for Sunday vs Chiefs TBD based on practice.
items.implication: Monitor; potential miss opens targets elsewhere in DEN.
items.opportunity: Courtland Sutton/Pat Bryant upside if out.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Very excited for Lamar unlock with Declan Doyle.
items.why: Elite YPRR efficiency even without Lamar; full practice unlocks.
items.opportunity: Route/target quality jump with healthy Lamar.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Prefer sell Olave over the unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer moving proven but sell-high/uncertain over rookie upside.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be big day vs Vikings defense pressuring Goff.
items.why: Matchup vs pressure defense favors TE targets.

items.text: Texans place WR Jaylin Noel on IR (toe) after claiming RB Emari Demercado.
Eagles place RB Dameon Pierce on IR and sign RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.implication: Saquon Barkley workload secure; Blue depth.

items.text: Jadarian Price is back, but can you put him right back into lineup?
items.why: Return from absence; role/lineup viability TBD.
items.opportunity: Potential committee or lead if volume returns.
